1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 d5 4.f3 c5 5.cxd5.strategy: Attacks the c5 pawn a second time: with d4 and the knight on it, and nothing guarding it, Black must resolve the tension at once. The knight stands on the edge, but the move gains a tempo.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 d5 4.f3 c5 5.cxd5.name: Grünfeld Defence: Lutikov Variation, Murrey Attack
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 d5 4.f3 c5 5.cxd5.background: A modified version of Ashot Nadanian's idea of Na4, it has been called the Neo-Nadanian.
